name: krawings-portal-app
description: Capacitor wrapper (appId de.krawings.portal) around https://portal.krawings.de with COMMITTED custom native code (Zebra Bluetooth print + barcode scanner) under android/. Built by .github/workflows/android-apk.yml, which runs Capacitor with this folder as CWD (never `cap add`) and resolves @capacitor/* from the repo-root node_modules.
